extractors.title: Extractors
extractors.intro: Separate programs that turn replays and levels from your own game installs into what 3DHeat reads. Installed in their own folder, started as programs of their own.
extractors.get.intro: Get the extractors: each one is a separate program you download from its releases page and run on your own machine. It reads the game from your own install and writes levels and tables that 3DHeat opens.
extractors.get.note: In the 3DHeat app, this panel installs, updates and starts them for you.
